I answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

Both sources are things Marcus can see himself. Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 during the morning shift. The public North team cheat sheet also lists Thea as QFL's main contact. Contact names count as operational facts, so sharing this with the North team doesn't need anyone's approval.
